title: P&L dashboard
brief: An interactive P&L tracking dashboard for 'Brume', a fictional D2C skincare brand — 18 months of coherent monthly data (revenue by channel, COGS, gross margin, opex by category, EBITDA, cash). KPI header cards, a monthly waterfall, margin trend, channel mix, opex breakdown, a month selector and channel filter; all data embedded, all views cross-filter.
da: Plum ledger — warm porcelain ground, near-black ink, one deep plum accent plus a muted warm neutral, hairline-ruled sharp-cornered cards, quiet row striping, no soft shadows; IBM Plex Sans + IBM Plex Mono for every numeral, account-book energy.
